description: The file defines the ProductionRun class used within the Apache OFBiz manufacturing plugin. It manages production run entities, including properties such as start and completion dates, quantities, related routing tasks, and components. It provides methods to read, update, and store production run data, as well as to recalculate estimated completion dates based on routing tasks and quantities.

classes.name: ProductionRun
classes.description: Represents a manufacturing production run; provides methods to manage production run data, routing tasks, components, and scheduling.
